Name: Weathered Golden Locket
Description: A locket that has the name ‘Callista’ on it with a picture of Milo, Tinita, and Callista in the picture. The locket was given by Callista to Tinita.

Name: Wedding Band
Description: A wedding band that is in the urn of Milo’s ashes. She feels guilty for not reciprocating his feelings.

Name: Canary Paint tube
Description: A tube of paint that Abuela often relies upon when creating her masterpieces; she thinks that the shade of yellow really brings out the best highlights.

Name: Fountain Pen
Description: A feathered fountain pen that is the same color as Crowley’s feathers.

Name: Bag of Prized Marbles
Description: A bag of marbles that Tinita had received as a child from Milo and Callista when they were children.

Name: Coin Collection
Description: Tinita’s coin collection that she has developed since she has gotten older.

Name: Wired Statue
Description: A statue that is not finished of her husband, Milo, who has unfortunately passed away.

Name: Rosary
Description: A rosary that is part of her faith and she holds dear. (We’ll need to discuss what religion she believes in)

Name: Silver Spoon
Description: A spoon that looks elegant and was given as a wedding gift when Tinita and Milo got married.

Name: Colorful Pitcher
Description: A pitcher made by her daughters and which got Tinita back into art again.

Name: Wooden Carved Bowl
Description: A wooden bowl that has been carved by her husband and contains a four-leaf clover, and the bowl is coated in epoxy.

Name: Picture of Family
Description: A dusty picture frame of Tinita, Milo, and their two daughters.
